observations: Photo 0 shows a steam generator iron with a blue and white body. The brand 'Tefal' and model 'PRO EXPRESS' are visible on the side of the base unit.

Photo 1 shows the iron head with control buttons, including power, boost, and steam settings. The brand 'Tefal' is visible on the front panel. The power cord is visible and appears to be a 3-prong plug.

Photo 2 shows the base unit from another angle, with 'Tefal' and 'PRO EXPRESS' visible again. A red button (likely for water release or steam) is visible on the front. The unit is placed on a bed with a floral sheet.
All photos show a watermark 'DAUDA SULEIMAN' and 'POSTED ON JIJI', indicating the seller and platform.
